name: Perryville Battlefield State Historic Site
description: A scenic historic site with gravel and grass trails winding through the Civil War battlefield. Ample parking and full facilities make this an excellent starting point for nearby rides.

name: Millennium Park
description: A well-maintained community park with paved paths and easy access to Danville's street network. Great launching point for road rides heading north or west out of town.

name: Pioneer Playhouse Trailhead
description: Informal gravel trailhead along Stanford Rd offering access to rural gravel roads south of Danville. Limited roadside parking — arrive early on weekends.
